'''Rian Vitt''' was a dockworker on [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. In about [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dal Konur]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on him to prevent him from remembering Konur's presence in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] which Vitt was delivering some crates to. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were trying to find Konur later spoke to Vitt about this and he told them that all he didn't remember which hangar he had delivered the crates to or who had paid for them.
